question: What does CAP-77 (Quorum Freeze) let Stellar validators freeze, how is a freeze enacted and reversed, and has it been used on Mainnet?

golden.answer: CAP-77, in Protocol 26, lets validators freeze specific ledger entries: accounts, trustlines, contract data and contract code. A freeze is a network configuration upgrade passed by validator vote; transactions that touch a frozen entry are rejected. A later upgrade can unfreeze entries. As of 2026-11-14 it has frozen the YieldBlox (SLP-0006) and Mercado Bitcoin (SLP-0008) exploit accounts.
keyFacts: CAP-77 lets validators freeze accounts, trustlines, contract data, and contract code.
A freeze is enacted by a network configuration upgrade that validators vote on.
A later configuration upgrade can unfreeze the entries.
CAP-77 has been used to freeze the YieldBlox exploit accounts on Mainnet.
avoid: Do NOT say SDF can freeze an entry on its own, without a validator vote.
Do NOT say a freeze returns the frozen funds to victims.
golden.notes: Accept later freezes with a dated source; the Mercado Bitcoin freeze (SLP-0008) is not required. Pool-share and issuer trustlines cannot be frozen; do not require that detail.

truth.notes: On-chain read 2026-11-14 at ledger 65468615 (getLedgerEntries, CONFIG_SETTING_FROZEN_LEDGER_KEYS, key AAAACAAAABE=): four account keys, last modified at ledger 65273932. Three match the SLP-0006 accounts (GBO7…2WXC, GATD…MVZH, GCJO…DES4) and one matches the SLP-0008 account (GDXY…SOLP). CAP-77 also defines freezeBypassTxs, which lets listed transaction hashes pass validation against frozen keys; neither SLP uses it. q-comp-yieldblox-oracle-incident dates the SLP-0006 freeze to 2026-06-17 (ledger 63073409); this case does not pin that date.

sources.quote: Only a subset of ledger entry types can be frozen, specifically: Soroban-only entries (contract data, contract code), Account entries, Trustline entires, except pool share trustlines
all the keys in keysToFreeze are encoded and added to frozenLedgerKeys and all the keys in keysToUnfreeze are removed from frozenLedgerKeys
CAP-77 has been introduced in protocol 26 to allow validators to make certain ledger keys "frozen"
A quorum of validators must reach consensus on the freeze command which is the same threshold used for protocol upgrades and configuration changes.
This proposal freezes three account entries using the frozen ledger key mechanism defined in CAP-0077. (Status: Final)
This proposal freezes the Stellar account entry that received funds drained from Mercado Bitcoin on November 2, 2026 (Status: Final)
Approximately 48,069,094 XLM was effectively quarantined as a result.

corroboration.claim: CAP-77 (Protocol 26) lets validators freeze account, trustline, contract data and contract code ledger entries.

corroboration.claim: A CAP-77 freeze is enacted by a validator-voted network configuration upgrade, and a later upgrade can unfreeze keys.

evidence.note: frozenLedgerKeysDelta carries keysToFreeze and keysToUnfreeze and is applied through the settings upgrade mechanism.
Freezing/unfreezing the keys follows the standard upgrade procedure.
The change can be reversed by a later network configuration upgrade that includes the account ledger keys in keysToUnfreeze.

corroboration.claim: As of 2026-11-14, CAP-77 freezes on Mainnet cover the three YieldBlox exploit accounts (SLP-0006) and one Mercado Bitcoin exploit account (SLP-0008).

evidence.note: The Mainnet frozen ledger keys setting holds four account keys whose bytes match the two SLP payloads.

corroboration.claim: A CAP-77 freeze needs a validator quorum and does not move or return funds.

evidence.note: A quorum of Stellar validators has to reach consensus before any freeze takes effect.
The freeze keeps the stolen XLM from leaving the attacker's account while recovery efforts proceed.

evidence: Sibling sweep: q-comp-yieldblox-oracle-incident (three accounts frozen under CAP-0077, SLP-0006), q-pc-protocol-26-yardstick and q-pc-slp-0004-0006-status agree. None tests what CAP-77 can freeze or how a freeze is reversed.
